title: TV Star Charlie Chauhan Marries KKR All-Rounder Ramandeep Singh After Eight-Year Romance
excerpt: The Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan actress and India T20I cricketer tied the knot in a traditional Sikh ceremony at a gurdwara on August 7.
body:
• Television actress Charlie Chauhan and KKR all-rounder Ramandeep Singh married in a traditional Sikh ceremony at a gurdwara on August 7, capping an eight-year relationship.
  • Chauhan, best known for her role as Mukti Vardhan in MTV's Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan, shared the first wedding photos with the caption "8 Years of Dreaming Together."
  • Ramandeep, 27, was a key player in KKR's IPL 2024 title-winning campaign and made his India T20I debut against South Africa in November 2024.
  • The couple kept the ceremony intimate, with close family and friends from both the entertainment and cricket worlds in attendance.

A Gurdwara Wedding After Eight Years Together

Indian television actress Charlie Chauhan and cricketer Ramandeep Singh tied the knot on August 7 in a traditional Sikh wedding ceremony at a gurdwara, according to News18. The couple, who had been in a relationship for eight years, kept the ceremony intimate, surrounded by close family and friends.

Chauhan shared the first photographs from the wedding on social media, captioning them "8 Years of Dreaming Together." The images showed the couple in traditional Punjabi wedding attire, completing the customary rituals at the gurdwara.

From MTV to the Cricket Pitch

Charlie Chauhan, 36, is best known for playing Mukti Vardhan in the popular MTV youth show Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan, which ran from 2014 to 2018 and became a cult hit among Indian teenagers. She began her career as a contestant on MTV Roadies 7 in 2009 and went on to star in Best Friends Forever? and competed on Nach Baliye 5 with then-partner Kunwar Amar.

"8 Years of Dreaming Together."

— Charlie Chauhan, on Instagram

Ramandeep Singh, a Punjab-born all-rounder, has carved out a reputation as one of Indian cricket's rising talents. He joined Kolkata Knight Riders ahead of the 2024 IPL season for ₹20 lakh and quickly became a key member of the squad, playing all 14 matches as KKR clinched the title. His performances earned him a retention at ₹4 crore for the 2025 and 2026 seasons.

International Debut and IPL Success

In November 2024, Ramandeep earned his India T20I debut against South Africa in Johannesburg, where he equalled Suryakumar Yadav's record on the very first ball of his debut match, according to Deccan Herald. He played two T20 internationals during that series, establishing himself as a versatile all-rounder capable of contributing with both bat and ball.

His IPL journey began with Mumbai Indians in 2022, where he was picked up for ₹20 lakh. After two quiet seasons, the move to KKR in 2024 transformed his career. Ramandeep's ability to finish innings and chip in with pace bowling made him indispensable in KKR's title run.

Celebrity-Cricketer Weddings Continue a Tradition

The Chauhan-Ramandeep union adds to a growing list of Indian celebrity-cricketer marriages that have captured public attention. From Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma to Kuldeep Yadav's recent wedding in Mussoorie, such pairings have become cultural touchstones for the Indian diaspora, bridging Bollywood and cricket — the two pillars of Indian popular culture.

The traditional Sikh ceremony, or Anand Karaj, was held at a gurdwara, following the couple's Punjabi heritage. While details of the guest list remain private, reports from Mid-Day and Livemint indicate that figures from both the IPL circuit and the television industry were present.

What's Next for the Newlyweds

With the IPL 2027 auction cycle approaching and KKR's continued investment in Ramandeep, the cricketer is expected to remain a central figure in the franchise's plans. Chauhan, who has been relatively selective with her screen appearances in recent years, has not announced any upcoming projects. For now, the couple's focus appears to be on celebrating their new chapter together.
